page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.24xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by AWS Graviton ARM64 processors. The server features 96 dedicated physical cores operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, with a single thread per core configuration. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core.

This instance includes 5700 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, which is bundled directly as instance store volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 50 Gbps, managed via the AWS Nitro hypervisor. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

Utilizing custom AWS Graviton ARM64 architecture offers a distinct hardware profile compared to traditional x86 platforms. The dedicated core allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource sharing, though workloads must be compatible with the arm64 instruction set. The high density of memory combined with substantial local NVMe storage provides a balanced resource profile for data-heavy tasks, offering qualitative cost efficiency by reducing the need for external network-attached storage.

The hardware configuration is designed for memory-intensive applications that require high-speed local storage. Suitable workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, big data analytics, and distributed file systems that benefit from the 50 Gbps network baseline and 5700 GB local NVMe SSD capacity.
